g.text: So. What made you want to go into the army and become a sniper?
So... when're you going to tell me the story about how you ended up as one of the Hex?
So... is now a good time to ask about how you ended up as one of the Hex?
sup sexy. n how r u this fine day?
n how r u this fine day?
story's 2 long 2 tell right now, i don't have that much time, sorry
Great. Are you going to answer my question? lol
great. so i'm hopin' things aren't about 2 go downhill
what? i can't be nice 2 my new favourite person b4 u get ur shovel out n start digging 4 shit?
Is there another story you can tell me you *do* have time for?
Are you sure? I feel like I've heard that before.
We don't have to talk about it, if you don't want to.
mmmm sure but it's gonna cost u
u keep flipping a coin and it keeps coming up tails. doesn't mean the coin is magic
shoulda named u sherlock instead. lol. but if u wanna know, i'll tell u, its no big deal
lmao i know that. ur not my drill sergeant n im not under investigation. but if u wanna know, i'll tell u
statistics says it'll comes 2 a 50/50 split but doesn't mean it do that in practice, does it? pick a better time, m8 lol
but it WILL cost u tho lol
Didn't figure you for a statistics and math guy.
Doesn't mean the coin is magic, But it might mean it's weighted.
Chat ends. Next chat will be QuincyTomorrow.
then u don't know me as well as u think u do. i only went in2 the army so i could get the money 2 go to college, m8
*More* favors?! What would this be now, four?!
*More* favors?! What would this be now, three?!
wanted 2 major in business or finance. maybe an MBA. i have more of a head for numbers
u already owe me 3 favours, whats 1 more? :P
u already owe me 2 favours, whats 1 more? :P
u already owe me 1 favour, whats 1 more? :P
(part of what made me a good sniper. u gotta do a lotta maths in ur head to take the right shot)
Chat ends. Next chat will be QuincyTomorrow.
nothin' sexual if that's what ur thinkin'. don't need 2 bribe u for that. ;)
lmao nothing big, nothing u'll regret. just a lil favour
Really? I would've expected you to go into photography or something like that.
The army pays for college here?
promise i won't use them for anything sexual lol. don't need 2 bribe u for that. ;)
I still can't quite figure out what you *are* going to use them for...
Sure. We've gotten this far. What's the worst that can happen?
LMAO u mental?! ur not listening 2 me. there ain't no money in the arts. naaah
that is 4 me 2 know and 4 u 2 find out :P
i wasn't doing this shit 4 me, m8. u don't know what it's like here, so i'll do my best 2 explain
some do. britannic army has a bursary - bank account, basically - that they pay u from if u spend a few years in the service
You better not make me regret this later.... Fine.
No, I just know this isn't going to go well for me later.
ppl like me don't get a whole lot of free opportunities in life, read me?
dunno how they do it elsewhere. u don't know what it's like here, so i'll do my best 2 explain
i didn't grow up with a whole lotta resources. i had what mattered when it mattered. i had family. friends. community
so. why'd ur quincy-k go into the army? same reason most ppl like me go into the army
but it was a lot of wheel-spinning. lotta scraping by. making the best of things. what i wanted was 2 get ahead. not just 4 me but 4 the ppl that mattered 2 me
but u have no idea what its like here, so... i get it. u have no idea what i'm talkin' about, so i'll do my best 2 explain
in order 2 do that? id need a 'real' education. get a 'real' job. decided i was gonna go to university. make a real something of myself 4 my fam
i didn't grow up with a whole lotta resources, get me? i had what mattered when it mattered. i had family. friends. community
i got a good head 4 numbers. 4 making deals. 4 business. n can u picture me in a suit?! mmm somethin crisp n slick? high end? hair tied back? i'd clean up PROPER nice
but it was a lot of wheel-spinning. lotta scraping by. making the best of things. what i wanted was 2 get ahead. not just 4 me but 4 the ppl that mattered 2 me
so i figured, join the army, spend a few years killing 4 them, then off i go to get a degree, 'n then i can start making Ps to bring home to my fam and community. start a new life
in order 2 do that? id need a 'real' education. get a 'real' job. decided i was gonna go to university. make a real something of myself 4 my fam
thats if shit doesn't go tits up b4 u get the chance...
Did you want to study photography?
What did you want to study?
LMAO u mental?! ur not listening 2 me. there ain't no money in the arts. naaah
something that'd get not just me ahead but that'd let me support the ppl i cared about
Who screwed it up for you?
Did you get kicked out of the army?
i was thinkin' business. finance. can u picture me in a suit? mmm somethin crisp n slick? high end? hair tied back? i'd clean up PROPER nice
u paid 4 the story of why i joined not how i left. u want that story? u gotta be like amir with 1 of his arcade machines
them sharks wouldn't stand a CHANCE. but we didn't have the funds 2 put me through uni, yeah?
oh u do learn quick. who do u THINK screwed it up 4 me? who do u think screws EVERYTHING up 4 me?!
but the army does. n they tell u that if u sign up, u get to apply 4 a bursary. u fight 4 them for a couple years, kill 4 em, n... then they pay 4 u 2 start a new life
Why do you keep doing this? Seriously? Can't we just *talk?*
I don't charge you favors when I tell you things.
His Maj just can't leave well enough alone sometimes, can he?
everything is give n take. everything is about exchange under the surface
Sounds like a story for another day.
either u owe me or i owe u, fact of life
But we're together, aren't we? Doesn't that change anything?
Do you ever wonder why the other Hex members aren't very close to you?
But we're friends, aren't we? Doesn't that change anything?
mkay sexy thing, i gtg. u hit me up later, yeah?
also 'cuz i gtg. see ya fam
oh u sweet child. being in a relationship w/ someone makes it worse not better lol
oh u sweet child, this is how *everything* works
i'm just brave enough 2 be honest with u, thats all. u gotta decide if u want that in ur life or not
mkay sexy thing, i gtg. u hit me up later, yeah?
also 'cuz i gtg. see ya fam
